en.title: Minimum Sum of Ranges over All Prefixes
en.description:
Rearrange the array, compute the maximum minus the minimum of every non-empty prefix, and add these ranges together. Find the minimum total.

This site independently wrote the standard I/O, examples, and judging.
en.input: The first line contains n (1..2000), and the second line contains n values (1..10⁹).
en.explanation: Example 1: the order 1, 2, 3 has prefix ranges 0, 1, 2, for a total of 3. Example 2: there is only one value, range 0. Example 3: place the two 1s first and then 5, giving ranges 0, 0, 4, for a total of 4.
hints: After sorting, use interval DP: dp[l,r]=a[r]−a[l]+min(dp[l+1,r],dp[l,r−1]), with cost 0 for a single element; keep only the layer whose length is one less in a rolling array.
